meta.notes: Florida-resident tuition and required fees only. Verify with MDConnect / an MDC advisor before relying on any requirement.

transfer_rules.aa_guarantee: An MDC AA guarantees admission to a Florida public university, not to a limited-access program.
fiu_default: C or higher in all prerequisites

fiu_exceptions.engineering: C or higher in two attempts or fewer (drops/withdrawals count); Calculus I ready
fiu_exceptions.architecture: 3.0 GPA, AA in Architectural Studies, design portfolio

transfer_rules.as_to_bachelors: AS courses don't all count as university gen-ed; MDC's own BS/BAS programs accept the AS directly.

meta.effective_term_note: Effective term depends on your most recent term of admission to the College. Students admitted before Fall 2024 can view their effective term on the Academic Requirements page in MDConnect (mdconnect.mdc.edu).

mathematics.rule: Select 1 course from State Core and 1 course from MDC Core. Lab units are not allowed in this area.

mdc_core.title: Jazz and Popular Music in America

general_education_elective.rule: Select one course from any of the following options.

pathway_electives.rule: Select electives by pathway and/or specialization; consult an advisor and your transfer institution. General education courses not used to meet gen-ed requirements may count here.

options: The College's approved computer competency test

civic_literacy.requirement: Complete a civic literacy course (AMH 2010, AMH 2020 or POS 2041) AND pass the Florida Civic Literacy Examination (FCLE).
civic_literacy.applies_to: AA or baccalaureate students entering an FCS or SUS institution in 2021-2022 or later; AS students entering in 2022-2023 or later.
civic_literacy.exception: First-time-in-college students who entered between Fall 2018 and Summer 2021 may pass a course or an approved assessment.

gordon_rule.W: Six semester hours of English coursework and six semester hours of additional coursework requiring college-level writing through multiple assignments.
gordon_rule.C: Six semester hours of mathematics coursework at the level of college algebra or higher.

general_education_standards.communication: Courses must afford students the ability to communicate effectively, including writing clearly and public speaking.
general_education_standards.humanities: Courses must afford students the ability to think critically through subjects concerned with human culture, especially literature, history, art, music, and philosophy, including selections from the Western canon.
general_education_standards.mathematics: Courses must afford students mastery of foundational mathematical and computation models and methods by applying them in problem solving.
general_education_standards.natural_science: Courses must afford students the ability to critically examine and evaluate the principles of the scientific method, model construction, and use the scientific method to explain natural experiences and phenomena.
general_education_standards.social_science: Courses must afford students an understanding of basic social and behavioral science concepts and principles used in analyzing behavior and past and present social, political, and economic issues.

general_education.official_requirements_note: Official graduation requirements are on the Academic Requirements page in MDConnect (mdconnect.mdc.edu).

notes: AA pathway guides list courses as options within requirements, not courses everyone must take (MDC AA Pathway Guide, effective Fall 2026).
Gen-ed lab credits are not allowed in the AA natural science area, so labs are excluded unless a corequisite is required.
The Computer Competency Test (CCT) demonstrates computer competency but awards no course credit. CGS 1060C is a 4-credit course.
Confirm against MDConnect Academic Requirements and the current FIU transfer guide.

career.summary: MDC targets AI Developer and AI Specialist roles. BLS has no AI-specific occupation at the associate level, so the closest BLS occupations with sub-bachelor entry are listed. The higher-paying AI occupations (Data Scientists, Software Developers) typically require the BS.
career.data_source: BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook; pay is May 2025, projections 2025-2035

occupations.title: Data Scientists
duties: Identify which data are available and useful for a project
Build, validate, test, and update algorithms and models
Use data visualization software to present findings
Recommend business actions to stakeholders based on their analysis

occupations.title: Software Developers
occupations.annual_openings_note: BLS gives openings only for the combined group (developers, QA analysts and testers).
duties: Analyze user needs and design and develop software to meet them
Recommend upgrades for existing programs and systems
Design the parts of an application and plan how they work together
Create models and diagrams that programmers use to write code
Document each aspect of an application or system

occupations.title: Computer and Information Research Scientists
duties: Explore computing problems and develop theories and models to address them
Collaborate with scientists and engineers on complex computing problems
Design and run experiments to test software systems, often using data science and machine learning
Analyze experimental results and publish findings
Develop new programming languages, software systems, and tools
